name: population_out
note: post-inhibition group output; emitted by all three models' CPU neuron_group_t::perform_observations (also by ngm3's neuron_group_gpu_t::perform_observations — out of scope).

name: population_out_pre_inhibition
note: pre-inhibition per-neuron drive; CPU only, emitted by ngm3 and ngm25 neuron_group_t::perform_observations. ngm2 has no separate pre-inhibition buffer (inhibition is in-place) and does not emit it. The ngm3/ngm25 GPU overrides also do not emit this site (TODO gpu-parity, deferred): the contract test is CPU-scoped.

name: population_in
note: proximal feedforward input (the presented sample); emitted by all three models' CPU neuron_group_t::perform_observations (also by ngm3's neuron_group_gpu_t::perform_observations — out of scope). ngm25's "in" is input_concat_ (proximal+apical already combined -- see population_in_apical below).

name: population_in_apical
note: top-down/context input; ngm3 CPU only, conditional on apical_cnt > 0, in neuron_group_t::perform_observations (also ngm3's neuron_group_gpu_t::perform_observations — out of scope). Dormant (not emitted) whenever apical_cnt == 0, e.g. configs/mnist_ngm3.json. ngm25 has no separate apical site -- its apical bank is folded into population_in's input_concat_ above -- and ngm2 has no apical bank at all.

name: neuron_activity
note: ngm2 per-entity site (no ngm3 equivalent — ngm3 is a flat group-leaf model with no neuron_t entities): ngm2 neuron_t::perform_observations.

name: dendrite_representation_count
note: ngm2 per-entity site: dendrite_t::perform_observations. Distinct from population_structure_representation_count below (same local_id pattern, different kind/entity level; safe because a run emits only one model's sites).

name: input_index
note: model-agnostic dataset-loader site, maps step -> sample index; emitted by the loaders' perform_observations: chairs3d_io, cifar_io_base, idx_io_base, dsprites_io.

name: population_structure_representation_count
note: group-total distinct seg_ids across all dendrites, one scalar per step; CPU only, emitted by ngm3 and ngm25 neuron_group_t::perform_observations via get_total_representation_count(). In its own group because that scan is expensive: a run observing only `population` must not pay for it. ngm2 has no group-total equivalent (its per-dendrite representation_count is an orthogonal leaf-bitmask occupation count) and does not emit this site. Reuses the ngm2 dendrite `^representation_count$` local_id pattern but is a distinct schema entry (kind=group_level vs per_dendrite); safe because a single run emits only one model's sites.
